`lib/synth.ts` is a TypeScript port of the sound effect synthesiser in
osrscachereader (https://github.com/Dezinater/osrscachereader at 8dbb297,
files SoundEffectLoader.js, InstrumentLoader.js, SoundEnvelope.js,
AudioFilter.js), corrected to the OSRS client's arithmetic. osrscachereader is
BSD-2-Clause; its licence is reproduced in LICENSE. No other osrscachereader
code is used.
